bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CHECKOUT_SHA=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'CHECKOUT_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)"
printf 'DOCKER_BIN=%s\n' "$(command -v docker || true)"
printf 'PNPM_BIN=%s\n' "$(command -v pnpm || true)"
printf 'APP_SCRIPT=%s\n' "$(test -f scripts/gserver_apps.py && echo LOCAL || echo NOT_HERE)"
printf 'HOME_APP_SCRIPT=%s\n' "$(test -f "$HOME/Project/Gserver/repository/scripts/gserver_apps.py" && echo YES || echo NO)"
printf 'EXISTING_BRIDGE_FILE=%s\n' "$(test -f "$HOME/.config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token" && echo YES || echo NO)"
printf 'DEPLOY_DIR=%s\n' "$(test -d deploy/secrets && echo YES || echo NO)"
docker ps --format 'LIVE_CONTAINER={{.Names}} IMAGE={{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -E '(gaybbs|postgres|tumblr)' || true
